newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Corp's impact on stocks seen small - Nomura.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Corp's impact on stocks seen small - Nomura.

text.p: Nomura Research Institute believes Sumitomo Corp's raised estimate of losses from unauthorised copper trading was likely to have a limited impact on the Tokyo stock market, Nomura Securities Co Ltd said on Friday.
Nomura Research said the market had been well aware of the possibility that Sumitomo's loss from the trading scandal could be beyond what had initially been expected.
Sumitomo Corp said on Thursday that the trading loss has soared to $2.6 billion from the $1.8 billion it originally estimated.
Considering that Sumitomo Corp's net asset per share has fallen due to the larger trading loss, Nomura Research calculated the trading house's price book-value ratio (PBR) at 1.1.
The research institute said that judging from the PBR, Sumitomo Corp's share price is reasonable.
The share price stood at 913 yen at Friday midday, down from Thursday's close at 939 yen.

Nomura Research is maintaining its rating for Sumitomo Corp at "2", the middle of its three-grade rating system. Nomura assigns a "2" rating to stocks whose values it sees moving within 10 percentage points in either direction of the 225-share Nikkei average over the next six months.
